bear_assumptions: 2027 revenue grows 30% from the USD 8.154 billion 2026 guidance midpoint, free-cash-flow margin normalizes to 35%, and 35x FCF plus USD 7.615 billion net liquid assets is divided by 2.75 billion diluted shares; growth decelerates sharply while stock compensation and customer concentration remain material.
base_assumptions: 2027 revenue grows 45% from the USD 8.154 billion guidance midpoint, free-cash-flow margin normalizes to 42%, and 50x FCF plus USD 7.615 billion net liquid assets is divided by 2.68 billion diluted shares; strong demand and margins persist while dilution moderates only gradually.
bull_assumptions: 2027 revenue grows 60% from the USD 8.154 billion guidance midpoint, free-cash-flow margin holds at 50%, and 65x FCF plus USD 7.615 billion net liquid assets is divided by 2.62 billion diluted shares; exceptional commercial and government growth persists while dilution eases.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a fresh scenario set clears expected-return, base-upside, bear/base, expected/bear and margin-of-safety gates at the then-current price while growth, customer conversion, GAAP margins, cash generation and per-share economics remain sound; downgrade the operating thesis if those fundamentals or dilution-adjusted economics deteriorate.
